CustomMetadata.label: Account Send Chatter Message - After Insert

values.value: Migrated from ATFE_SendChatterMessage trigger (originally after insert, after update - update leg was a no-op since the body only ran under trigger.isInsert, so only an after-insert action was generated; source trigger is now Inactive - see its own meta.xml - rather than deleted): posts a Chatter feed notification to NA_Account_Ops / EMEA_Account_Ops group members when a new Account is created by a user with a valid price book region (NA/EMEA), excluding one hardcoded profile Id from source.
